annotation_policy.unit: Whole physical outer silhouettes; square/near-rectangular floppy disks count as rectangles; coin outer silhouettes count as circles.
annotation_policy.exclude: Internal slots, printed text, holes, labels, shadows and small texture regions are not separate target objects.
annotation_policy.coordinates: xywh, half-open, in distributed image pixels. Images have maximum side 800.
annotation_policy.annotation_quality: Manually checked pilot labels; no second annotator or pixel-accurate masks. Stress occlusion bboxes are estimates.

audit.statistical_scope: Small convenience sample, not a representative real-world benchmark.

roi_diagnostic.warning: Oracle bbox location is provided. This diagnostic is NOT complete-frame detection accuracy.
